SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVENTORY_TRANSFER it JOIN ITEM i ON it.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID
AND (it.TRANSFER_NO LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

SELECT it.TRANSFER_ID, it.TRANSFER_NO, it.ITEM_ID, it.FROM_WH_ID, it.TO_WH_ID, it.QUANTITY, it.STATUS, it.REMARK, it.CREATED_AT, it.EMP_ID as empId, i.ITEM_CODE, i.ITEM_NAME, cc.CODE as itemUnit, fw.WH_NAME as fromWhName, tw.WH_NAME as toWhName, e.EMP_NAME FROM INVENTORY_TRANSFER it JOIN ITEM i ON it.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID JOIN WAREHOUSE fw ON it.FROM_WH_ID = fw.WH_ID JOIN WAREHOUSE tw ON it.TO_WH_ID = tw.WH_ID JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON it.EMP_ID = e.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON i.UNIT_CODE = cc.CODE_ID AND cc.CODE_TYPE = 'UNIT_CODE' WHERE it.TRANSFER_ID = #{transferId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'IT' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') || LPAD(SEQ_INVENTORY_TRANSFER_NO.NEXTVAL, 5, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO INVENTORY_TRANSFER ( TRANSFER_NO, ITEM_ID, FROM_WH_ID, TO_WH_ID, QUANTITY, STATUS, REMARK, EMP_ID, TRANSFER_DATE, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{transferNo}, #{itemId}, #{fromWhId}, #{toWhId}, #{quantity}, '대기', #{remark}, #{empId}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE INVENTORY_TRANSFER SET STATUS = '취소', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRANSFER_ID = #{transferId}
